v1_failure: Safety net v1 (amount >= 99th pct of legit, force Hold) added ₹7,703 in false-positive friction with ZERO increase in fraud prevented — all 14 triggers landed on legit transactions. Root cause: anchoring on a legit-distribution percentile guarantees a fixed false-positive rate but gives no guarantee of catching missed fraud, since missed fraud amounts may sit below that threshold.
diagnostic: 7 fraud cases were fully missed (Allow); 7 of those had amounts below the v1 threshold, confirming v1 could never have caught them.
v2_design: Requires moderate amount (75th pct legit) AND a corroborating behavioral flag, with a softer OTP Verify floor instead of Hold — proportionate to weaker evidence, targeted at actual gap cases.
